intro.zh: 教室里的时钟已经走到 23:59，Canvas 红点闪烁。你准备交上什么样的一学期？
intro.en: The clock reads 23:59 and the Canvas alert blinks. What kind of semester are you ready to submit?

intro.zh: Mei 声称一杯咖啡可以挽救整个学期。先和她聊聊，再找一份散落的笔记。
intro.en: Mei claims one coffee can rescue an entire semester. Talk to her, then find a lost Field Note.

title.en: Go to sleep: the CPU needs cooling

result.zh: Mei 为你颁发一张‘正常作息稀有生物’奖状。
result.en: Mei awards you a certificate for being a rare creature with a sleep schedule.

title.zh: 四倍浓缩：对 DDL 宣战
title.en: Quad espresso: declare war on the deadline

result.zh: 你的手速提高了，心跳和风扇转速也同步提高。
result.en: You type faster. Your pulse and laptop fan also reach escape velocity.

intro.zh: Maya 说有队友两周没回消息。问问 Ethan，再决定要不要帮忙。
intro.en: Maya says a teammate has been missing from the chat for two weeks. Ask Ethan, then decide what to do.

result.zh: 他们给你在致谢里加了名字，你终于出现在小组群消息中。
result.en: They add you to the acknowledgements. Someone finally replies in the group chat.

result.zh: 你躲过了消息，却没躲过小组互评。
result.en: You escape the messages, but not the peer evaluation.

intro.zh: Aisha 说末班校车又是大学生的有氧考场。找到她，然后上车。
intro.en: Aisha calls the last shuttle a compulsory cardio assessment. Talk to her, then board it.

title.zh: 在校车附近按 X 乘车

title.en: Share your seat with a late student

result.zh: 你收获了一句谢谢，而校车广播宣布你是本周优秀人类。
result.en: You earn a thank-you, and the shuttle declares you Human of the Week.

result.zh: 你获得座位一张，校园人缘减三，良心在下一站下车。
result.en: You gain one seat. Your conscience gets off at the next stop.

intro.zh: 实验记录神秘失踪。收集三份散落的笔记，再去 ERC 的概念室内看看。
intro.en: The lab record has vanished. Collect three Field Notes and explore the ERC concept interior.

title.en: Return the notebook with proper credit

result.zh: 实验没变完美，但研究诚信保住了。打印机为你鼓掌了一秒。
result.en: The experiment isn't perfect, but the record is honest. Even the printer applauds.

title.en: Copy the results and claim them

result.zh: 报告看似完美，查重系统突然睁开了眼睛。
result.en: The report looks flawless. The plagiarism detector suddenly opens its eyes.

intro.zh: 校园四站盖章与 Sprint 竞速将成为你对抗 DDL 的证据：至少你真的动过。
intro.en: The four campus checkpoints and a Sprint run prove you can move when a deadline approaches.

result.zh: 你提交了真实的结果。老师说：‘很好，下周继续。’
result.en: You submit honest results. Your supervisor says, 'Great. More next week.'

title.zh: 把‘未完成’写成‘基本完成’

result.zh: 数据在 PPT 上一片大好，现实在底下默默保存了截图。
result.en: The PowerPoint looks perfect. Reality quietly takes screenshots.

intro.zh: Daniel 说 UTown 的时钟会吞掉 DDL。雨夜去找他、收集六份笔记，再夺一枚竞速金牌。
intro.en: Daniel claims the UTown clock eats deadlines. Find him, collect six notes, witness the rain and win Sprint gold.

title.zh: 与 Daniel 讨论时间悖论
获得一次 Sprint 金牌
title.en: Win a Campus Sprint gold medal

result.zh: 你让 03:00 变成了 03:01。整个校园感动得差点交上作业。
result.en: You turn 3:00 into 3:01. The campus almost submits its assignments in gratitude.

result.zh: DDL 不再来临，但周一重复了四百次。
result.en: The deadline never arrives. Unfortunately, Monday repeats four hundred times.

title.zh: 隐藏结局 · 时间管理员

story.zh: 你解开了 03:00 的时间循环，向全校发了一封‘DDL 不会自动延期’的公告。Daniel 神秘地消失，只留下一张写着‘明早八点见’的纸条。你成功毕业，也终于知道早八才是最终 Boss。
story.en: You break the 3:00 a.m. time loop and announce that deadlines do not extend themselves. Daniel disappears, leaving a note: 'See you at 8 a.m.' You graduate, only to discover that 8 a.m. lectures were the final boss.

hint.zh: 完成时间怪谈，并保持诚信与人缘。
hint.en: Solve the clock mystery while protecting honesty and friendships.

story.zh: 你救回了小组作业、归还实验笔记，还在末班校车上让了座。毕业典礼上，校长准备发表长篇演讲，你递上了一份一页版总结。全场起立鼓掌。
story.en: You save the group project, return the missing research notes and make room on the final shuttle. At graduation you hand the chancellor a one-page summary instead of a two-hour speech. Standing ovation.

hint.zh: 做出善意的选择，并保持学术诚信。
hint.en: Make generous choices and maintain academic integrity.

title.zh: 好结局 · DDL 幸存者

story.zh: 你没有拯救世界，也没打败所有 DDL，但至少在最后一刻交出了自己的作业。邮件提示：‘提交成功。’下一秒跳出：‘新学期选课开始。’
story.en: You don't save the world or defeat every deadline, but you submit your own assignment on time. An email says 'Submission successful.' One second later: 'Course registration is now open.'

hint.zh: 坚持交作业且未触发其他重大危机。
hint.en: Submit your work without triggering a major crisis.

title.zh: 坏结局 · 咖啡机继承人
title.en: Bad Ending · Heir to the Coffee Machine

story.zh: 你靠四杯浓缩赶完报告，却忘了自己上次睡觉是哪一年。咖啡厅把你列为了永久会员，电脑风扇获得了最佳协作奖。
story.en: You finish the report on four espressos and forget which year you last slept. The cafe names you its lifetime patron, and your laptop fan wins Best Supporting Actor.

hint.zh: 压力过高、缺少支持时继续硬撑。
hint.en: Push on under extreme stress without support.

title.zh: 坏结局 · 学术诚信警报

story.zh: 你用完美的 PPT 遮住了不完美的数据。查重系统开始播放警报，Dr. Plot Twist 说：‘反转来了，请重做实验。’你获得了终身免费返工券。
story.en: You hide imperfect data behind perfect slides. The integrity alarm sounds and Dr. Plot Twist announces: 'Plot twist! Repeat the experiment.' You win a lifetime supply of rework.

hint.zh: 多次选择不诚实的捷径。

title.en: Bad Ending · The Deadline Black Hole

story.zh: 你选择‘明天再说’。电脑日历把明天复制成了 9999 年，Canvas 的红点缓缓升起，成为校园第二颗太阳。你的毕业论文标题：《论永远的明天》。
story.en: You decide to do it tomorrow. Your calendar copies tomorrow into the year 9999, Canvas notifications become a second sun, and your thesis is titled 'On the Eternal Tomorrow'.

hint.zh: 最后的 DDL 事件中选择彻底摆烂。
hint.en: Choose to give up at the final deadline.
